summary: The error about failing to set permissions on temporary files when becoming an unprivileged user is fixed by installing the package that provides setfacl, often acl.
questions: How do I fix 'Failed to set permissions on the temporary files Ansible needs to create when becoming an unprivileged user'?

answer_card.title: Fixing the temporary file permissions error
answer_card.answer_md: Install the package that provides `setfacl` on the managed host, usually **`acl`** (check your OS docs).
